limitations: Every exact-touch point is an explicit PWL knot; this does not isolate behavior of an unannounced smooth minimum.
Sampled guard is the value observed in the event block, not an internal root-detector or iteration trace.
The fixed voltage observation allowance is an assumption, not a proven physical bound.
No runtime semantics change, no original 31-condition denominator change, no speed comparison.

checker_packaging_fix.explanation: Shared unittest discovery exposed a same-name report.py import collision. The published runner resolves its owning helper by file path. All original function ASTs except the metadata wrapper analyze are identical; all waveform/event checks use the frozen runner. Six stop-setting checks were reanalyzed using the log display interval and the exact waveform endpoint; original failures are retained.
